stage1.impression: A dim, warm-ish room with a record wall, a frosted screen and a red glowing speaker. The light is flat and comes from nowhere: there are no pools, no practical lamps in frame and no highlights. The surfaces are smooth and smeared by the denoiser (the concrete has no board marks at 1:1, and the record spines are mush). The speaker reads as a lit red box with a sign hovering on rods above it, more display case than kissa. Competent CG, not a photograph.

blocking_9: Light comes from visible or implied practicals: at least two distinct pools on the wall or bar with dark between them (back wall lum_range >= 55, not the current 30)
The speaker is the brightest, clearest object in the frame: region median >= 45 (now 30.7), with its acrylic edges glowing and the horn readable
Material detail survives at 1:1: board-form grain, tie holes and pour lines on the concrete, distinct record spines, no denoiser smear
The screen sits in the room's warm key rather than as a neutral grey-blue slab, and its image reads as a soft fogged form, not a dirty smudge

A believable photographer's frame: the speaker larger in frame, foreground chair composed rather than cut off at the edge, a sign of life (a glass with a highlight, a record out of its sleeve, a candle)
Real highlights: frame p99 well above the current 109, with specular glints on glasses, steel and vinyl

defects.what: Speaker underexposed (median 30.7, below the 45 target); its glow is an even red fill with no edge glow and no depth, so it reads as signage or a lightbox
The upper smoked-red panel looks like a separate sign floating on two thin rods; dull (median 23), no clean reflections
Concrete wall uniformly lit (y profile 34 to 43, range 30), smooth, no board grain or tie holes visible; no pools of light
Left wall brighter (median 49) than the back wall, an unexplained flat fill
Frosted screen reads cool neutral grey (R46 G41 B42) against a warm room; its image is a dark ring with spikes that reads as a stain or a burnt hole; frame edges soft (step 7.9 over 11 px)
Record spines smeared by the denoiser, with no individual sleeves or highlights; saturated spine colours compete faintly with the speaker
Leather chairs cropped awkwardly at the left edge, red-tinted and featureless (median 18), with no leather grain or sheen
The side table's glasses read as dark blocks, with no liquid and no specular highlights
Fir beams overhead barely legible (median 28.7), with no checks or end grain
Low resolution (scale 0.3) and an overall soft, smeared look; no practicals bright anywhere (p99 109, clip 0%)

changes.problem: The hero speaker is too dark and too flat to carry the frame.

evidence.measured: lum_median 30.7, p95 125; the upper panel median 23

change.setting: lamps: on each Ember speaker 4 x area, W/m2 at the target

changes.expected: The speaker becomes the brightest object, with its acrylic edges and white batts glowing; region median about 50 to 60

changes.problem: The room is lit by an even fill with no pools, so it reads as CG rather than a night interior.

evidence.measured: back wall lum_range 30.2, y profile 33.6 to 43.1; the left wall median 49 is brighter than the back wall

change.setting: street lamps 2 x point / record wall 3 x spot
change.from: street 500 W; record wall 8 W, cone 18 deg
change.to: street 120 W; record wall 30 W, cone 24 deg, aimed to graze the shelf faces and spill a pool onto the concrete beside the speaker

changes.expected: Dark between pools, a visible grazing pool on the record wall and concrete, and the left-wall fill gone

changes.problem: The frosted screen is a cool grey slab that competes with the speaker, and its image reads as a stain.

evidence.measured: lum_median 41.9, R46 G41 B42 (neutral to cool under 3000 K white balance), about as bright as the speaker

change.setting: the screens' images emission / frosted acrylic roughness
change.to: 0.4, with the screen content shifted to about 3200 K; frosted roughness up so the image blurs into a soft fogged form

changes.expected: The screen glows softly and evenly, warm-neutral, darker than the speaker, and the image reads as a fogged silhouette

changes.problem: The denoiser smears the concrete, the record spines and the leather, which says render at 1:1.

evidence.measured: spines and shelf edges soft; concrete shows no board grain at a 2x crop

change.to: 1024 samples, adaptive 0.01, denoiser with albedo and normal passes at high-quality prefilter, judged at scale 0.5 or more

changes.expected: Individual record sleeves, formwork grain and leather texture survive

changes.problem: The concrete and fir read as smooth CG surfaces with no scale cues.

evidence.measured: p5 19.7 to p95 50.0 across the whole wall, uniform texture

change.setting: the concrete's tone and sheen / the stain of the fir
change.to: stronger board-form relief (bump on 100 to 150 mm boards), tie holes, faint staining and a slight sheen so grazing light picks them out; fir a stain lighter, with checks and end grain

changes.expected: Grazing light from c2 reveals the formwork pattern; the beams read as old fir

changes.problem: The 24 mm frame keeps the speaker small and central and cuts the chair off at the edge, a showroom look.

evidence.measured: chair cropped at x 0 with no form; the speaker occupies about 17% of the frame width

change.to: about 0.6 m closer and seated eye height 1.1 m, 35 mm, with the chair's back as a deliberate soft foreground in the lower left third

changes.expected: The speaker fills about a quarter to a third of the frame width, and the room reads closer and cozier

changes.problem: There is no sign of life and no small highlights; the glasses are dark blocks.

evidence.measured: the table region reads as dark shapes, with no speculars

change.to: a rocks glass with amber liquid and ice, a candle in an amber votive on the side table (candle 3 W, 1900 K), and a record out of its sleeve leaning on the table or the chair

changes.expected: A warm local pool and small bright highlights on the glass and vinyl

changes.problem: The frame has no real highlights or depth in the blacks; the tonal range is compressed.

change.to: AgX, look Medium High Contrast, exposure -0.2 kept, haze 0.04 so the speaker lamps and record spots bloom slightly

changes.expected: Deeper shadows with detail and brighter practicals and speculars; the frame median stays at 30 to 45

out_of_scope.request: The smoked-red top panel on two thin rods reads as a floating sign; it would read better seated flush or more substantial.
out_of_scope.why: It is part of the speaker's fixed shape and parts.

out_of_scope.request: Desaturate the record spines so the speaker is the only colour.
out_of_scope.why: The record wall is part of the fixed room design; only its light may change.

out_of_scope.request: Replace the screen's ring-and-spike image with a clearer fogged-hand or silhouette motif.
out_of_scope.why: What the screens show is fixed; only their brightness and the frosting change (c3).
